question.problem: What is the value of $f(t)=2{e}^{t}\,i+\sqrt{t+4}\,j+(t-2)^{4}\,k$ at $t=0?$
question.worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=0$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(0) & =2{e}^{0}\,i+\sqrt{0+4}\,j+(0-2)^{4}\,k \\  & =2\,i+2\,j+16\,k\end{aligned}
$$

So, the value of $f(t)$ at $t=0$ is the vector $2\,i+2\,j+16\,k.$
